mapper.insert: INSERT INTO medical_lab_results ( patient_id, test_date, test_doctor, test_department, temperature, heart_rate, respiratory_rate, systolic_bp, diastolic_bp, spo2, wbc, neutrophil_ratio, lymphocyte_ratio, monocyte_ratio, platelet, crp, pct, esr, ph, po2, pco2, hco3, create_by, create_time, remark, is_deleted ) VALUES ( #{patientId}, #{testDate}, #{testDoctor}, #{testDepartment}, #{temperature}, #{heartRate}, #{respiratoryRate}, #{systolicBp}, #{diastolicBp}, #{spo2}, #{wbc}, #{neutrophilRatio}, #{lymphocyteRatio}, #{monocyteRatio}, #{platelet}, #{crp}, #{pct}, #{esr}, #{ph}, #{po2}, #{pco2}, #{hco3}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{remark}, 0 )
